Okay, settle this for us. Both are 1980s Jasco lint brushes in hand-painted matte bisque porcelain, with a velvet pad underneath that lifts lint off coats and sweaters. The swan has pale sky-blue wings and a bright orange bill. The pelican tucks his long golden bill against his chest and still has his original Jasco label.

Cobalt blue, head to toe. This Indiana Glass fairy lamp is pressed in the Chantilly pattern, with embossed florals over the whole dome shade and a tall stemmed pedestal base. Circa 1970s to 1980s, two pieces, in excellent vintage condition. Drop a tealight inside and the pattern lights up.

Where would she live at your place: vanity, bookshelf or nightstand?
